project.title: Unravelling Bovine Preadipocyte Differentiation and their Three-Dimensional Cultivation for Cellular Agriculture
project.projectDescription: Isolation and characterisation of Bovine preadipocytes harvested from adipoce tissue. The cell type and source was confirmed usinf RNA-seq, and the cell type was further confirmed through proteomics.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Proteomics Analysis. Protein analysis was performed on differentiated adipocytes and control cultures (in triplicates) using the Mass Spectrometry facility at the Australian Proteome Analysis Facility (APAF). Briefly, 50µg of protein per sample were prepared for trypsin digestion. For each sample, volumes were normalised with 100 mM TEAB and 1% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDC). Disulfide bonds were reduced with DTT (10mM) at 60°C for 30 minutes, followed by alkylation with IAA (20mM) in the dark at room temperature for 30 minutes. Proteins were then digested with trypsin (1:25 enzyme-to-protein ratio) for 16 hours at 37°C. Post-digestion, peptides were acidified with 1% formic acid, desalted using Stage-Tip purification and dried via vacuum centrifugation. The dried peptides were reconstituted in 0.1% formic acid and loaded onto the peptide trap (C18 PepMap 100, 5μm, 100 Å, 300μm × 5mm, Thermo Fisher), which was then switched in line with the analytical nano-LC column (UltiMate 3000, Thermo Fisher). Peptides were eluted from the trap onto the nano-LC column and were separated with a stepped gradient of 2 % mobile phase B to 8 % mobile over 1 min, then 8 to 25% in 87 minutes, followed by 25 to 40 minutes in 5 minutes at a flow rate of 300 nL/min, and lastly 95 % mobile phase B for 10 minutes. the column eluent was directed into the ionization source of the Q-Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher) operating in positive ion and data independent acquisition (DIA) mode. Using collisional induced dissociation, DIA was performed using a resolution of 30,000 at 200m/z, spanning a range from 395 to 1005m/z.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: LC-MS/MS raw files were analysed using DIA-NN (version 1.8.1) software with a library-free approach, utilising an in silico spectral library based on the annotated Bos taurus protein sequences from the UniProt database (March 2020 release; 37,513 entries). Normalised log2 fold change (log2FC) was calculated by comparing induced preadipocyte data with non-induced preadipocyte data, and the false discovery rate (FDR)/q-value was set at 0.05. For KEGG pathway enrichment analysis, significantly upregulated proteins (log2FC >1) were compared against the total 2039 proteins detected from proteomics using the WEB-based GEne SeT AnaLysis Toolkit (WebGestalt).
